description: Small, nimble and easy to overlook.

traits.name: Lucky
traits.description: When rolling a 1 on an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, reroll the die and use the new roll.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: Can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: Can attempt to hide when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger.
